name: planning-with-files
description: Persistent file-based planning for multi-step AI-agent work. Keeps task_plan.md, findings.md, and progress.md on disk; lifecycle hooks inject selected project planning context. Automatic recovery read
descriptionZh: 实现Manus风格的文件规划，用于组织和跟踪复杂任务进度。创建task_plan.md、findings.md、progress.md。适用于需要时。

en.tagline: Disk-based planning files for multi-step AI agent work
en.summary: planning-with-files keeps a task's plan, findings, and progress in markdown files on disk, so an AI agent can work across many tool calls without relying on its context window. Lifecycle hooks inject the selected plan's context while the agent works. The skill has no network upload path, and it reads session history only when the user explicitly asks.
problem: Multi-step tasks with many tool calls outgrow the agent's context window. Earlier findings, decisions, and errors can drop out of view, and a resumed session may not know where the work stopped.

With this skill, the plan lives in task_plan.md, findings.md, and progress.md in the project. The agent re-reads the plan before decisions, records each discovery and error as it happens, and recovers its position from these files after a gap or compaction.
fit: Research or build work that needs 5 or more tool calls
Multi-phase tasks that may be resumed in a later session
Several independent tasks in one repository, each with its own named plan
unfit: Single-file edits that need no tracked phases
steps: On resume, the skill resolves one plan directory, reads its task_plan.md, progress.md, and findings.md, and runs git diff --stat to catch unrecorded code changes.
For a new task, the agent runs the init-session script to create the plan files from the shipped templates before starting implementation.
The check-complete script with --validate confirms the phase markers are in the expected format before and after structural changes.
Lifecycle hooks inject the selected plan's context on prompts, tool use, stop, and compaction events.
The agent saves findings after discoveries, logs errors and progress as work proceeds, and updates the Next Step line when a phase status changes.

The check-complete script reports whether all phases are complete. The optional /plan-goal and /plan-loop commands, where the host supports them, keep the agent working until the plan reports complete.

zh.tagline: 面向多步骤智能体任务的磁盘规划文件
zh.summary: planning-with-files 把任务的计划、发现和进度记录在磁盘上的 Markdown 文件里，让 AI 智能体在多次工具调用中不必依赖上下文窗口保存状态。生命周期钩子会在工作过程中注入所选计划的上下文。该技能没有网络上传路径，只有在用户明确要求时才会读取会话历史。
problem: 需要多次工具调用的多步骤任务，很容易超出智能体的上下文窗口。早期的发现、决定和错误可能被挤出视野，恢复会话后，智能体也可能不清楚工作停在哪里。
使用该技能后，计划保存在项目中的 task_plan.md、findings.md 和 progress.md 里。智能体在做决定前重新阅读计划，发现和错误出现时立即记录，并在中断或上下文压缩后从这些文件恢复当前位置。
fit: 需要 5 次或更多工具调用的研究或构建工作
可能在之后的会话中继续推进的多阶段任务
同一代码仓库中多个相互独立的任务，各自使用独立的命名计划
unfit: 不需要跟踪阶段的单文件修改
steps: 恢复工作时，技能先确定唯一的计划目录，读取其中的 task_plan.md、progress.md 和 findings.md，并运行 git diff --stat 查找尚未记录的代码改动。
新任务开始前，智能体运行初始化脚本，依据随附模板生成计划文件。
结构调整前后，使用带 --validate 参数的 check-complete 脚本确认阶段标记格式正确。
在提示、工具调用、结束和压缩事件发生时，生命周期钩子会注入所选计划的上下文。
发现新信息后，智能体立即保存；工作推进时记录错误和进度；阶段状态变化时更新下一步说明。
check-complete 脚本报告所有阶段是否完成。在宿主支持的情况下，可选的 /plan-goal 和 /plan-loop 命令会让智能体持续工作，直到计划显示完成。
